newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks leap higher in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks leap higher in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London pushed higher on Friday, tracking a surge in U.S. Treasury bonds after U.S. jobs data gave further evidence of a slowdown in growth and eased pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates.

Interest-rate sensitive bank and property stocks led the advance as the Hang Seng London Reference Index of leading Hong Kong shares rose 124.48 points to 12,029.99, reversing a 109-point decline earlier in Hong Kong.
"The market started quiet but after the employment figures there was an immediate reversal of the trend," said a trader at one major securities house in London.
"We're likely to sail back through the 12,000 mark on Monday, the liquidity-led rally in Hong Kong should continue."
